ValidationRule.description: When level 3 or level 3 not interested is selected, require the "What kind of Demo was completed"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (TEXT(Oasis_Event_Result__c) = 'Level Three - Demo Complete- Int' || ISPICKVAL(Oasis_Event_Result__c , 'Level Three- Demo Completed - Not Interested') ) && (ISNULL(What_kind_of_demo_was_completed__c) || ISBLANK(What_kind_of_demo_was_completed__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill out the What Kind of Demo was completed field.
